coinbase_wrapped_xrp.source: Coinbase official cbXRP Proof of Reserves
coinbase_wrapped_xrp.backing: Coinbase states cbXRP is backed 1:1 by XRP held by Coinbase

morpho_primary_market.source: MorphoWatch public page states data from Morpho API and public blockchain; it identifies this as the market behind Coinbase XRP loans
morpho_primary_market.attribution: STRONG_PUBLIC_DATA_INFERENCE; permissionless market; borrower set is not proven to be exclusively Coinbase retail users

coinbase_consumer_product.availability: Eligible U.S. users excluding New York
coinbase_consumer_product.execution: Coinbase interface to Morpho on Base

derived_measures.method_2: 1 - 49/62.5, ignores accrued interest, borrower top-ups, repayments and market-price/oracle differences
derived_measures.caveat: Aggregate market ratio is not an individual borrower health metric.

capital_classification.float_effect: May reduce immediately available underlying XRP while wrapped collateral remains locked; not permanent removal and not equal to net buying demand.

circle_link.relationship: INDIRECT_ECONOMIC_LINK: Circle-issued USDC is borrowed against Coinbase-wrapped XRP through a Morpho market; no evidence Circle directly lends or funds the market.
circle_link.complementary_and_competitive: USDC supports XRP-collateralized credit while Circle's Arc uses USDC as gas and competes for stablecoin payment flows.

data_quality.issue: Morpho market is permissionless; public attribution to Coinbase's retail product is based on market parameters and MorphoWatch analysis, not an issuer-signed market identifier.
data_quality.treatment: Keep as strong inference; do not attribute all 12,007 borrowers to Coinbase.

data_quality.issue: Market-specific 16:01 UTC snapshot differs from later 18:11 UTC network aggregate.
data_quality.treatment: Preserve both timestamps and do not average.

data_quality.issue: 49% initial LTV is Coinbase UI maximum; 62.5% LLTV is market liquidation threshold. The market itself is permissionless.
data_quality.treatment: Keep product cap and protocol threshold separate.

data_quality.issue: cbXRP issuance wraps XRP already held in Coinbase custody; USDC borrow is debt.
data_quality.treatment: Do not classify as new XRP spot demand or net capital inflow.
